name: imini
description: imini Open Platform integration — async image/video generation code helper across nano-banana, gpt-image-2, kling, seedance, happyhorse, and more.

install.note: The Codex bundled installer (~/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/) does not auto-discover SKILL.md outside the repo root. Pass --path explicitly as shown.

interface.shortDescription: Generate image/video integration code for imini Open Platform
interface.longDescription: Turn Codex into an imini integration helper. The skill picks the right AIGC model (nano-banana, gpt-image-2, kling, seedance, happyhorse, motion-control, and more), estimates credit cost, fetches the live OpenAPI spec, and generates production-ready async submit-and-poll code in Python / Node / TypeScript / cURL with correct status enum handling (succeeded / failed), result iteration (no [0] indexing), jitter, 429 backoff, and structured error preservation.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Python client that creates a 1080P video with kling-v3 and polls until complete
Write Node.js code to generate a 4K image with nano-banana-pro
Estimate the credit cost for generating 100 720P 5-second videos with seedance-2.0-fast
Set up a TypeScript helper to call gpt-image-2 with high quality + 2K resolution
